mt: 每个田间的土壤pH

en: Open Start and type your farm name and your own limits in the yellow cells: healthy pH, organic matter target, margin per hectare you want, warning days and the share of rain a crop can use.
mt: 打开"开始",然后在黄色的单元中输入农场名称和自己的限制:健康pH值,有机物目标,你想要的每公利率,预警日和作物可以使用的降雨量.

en: Wind that stops all work, km/h
mt: 停止所有工作的风,km/h

en: Irrigation pump 30 kW
mt: 灌 30 kW

en: Rain in the month, mm
mt: 月份的雨,mm

en: Target yield, t/ha
mt: 目标产量,t/ha

en: Average yield, t/ha
mt: 平均产量,t/ha

en: Area sprayed, ha
mt: 喷涂的区域,ha

en: Yield on the field area, t/ha
mt: 田面的产量,t/ha

en: Faster work 14 ha/h
mt: 工作速度更快 14 ha/h

en: Hello, today's work order for {field}: {task} with {machine}, {planned_ha} ha in {hours_plan} hours. Operator: {operator}. Please confirm before 7:00.
mt: 您好,今天的工作顺序为: {field} {task} {machine}, {planned_ha} ha 在 {hours_plan} 小时.操作员: {operator} 请在 7:00 之前确认.

en: Hello {supervisor}, we may have a spray window tomorrow on {field} ({crop}, {area_ha} ha). Check the wind at 6:00 and tell me if the team can start.
mt: 您好,我们可能会在明天的喷雾窗口. 检查6点的风,告诉我团队是否可以开始.

en: Hello {supervisor}, the wind is too strong for spraying. Stop the sprayer on {field} ({crop}) and wait until it drops. Tell me when you restart.
mt: 您好,风力太大了,不能喷雾. 停止喷雾器,等到它下降. 告诉我当你重新启动.

en: Hello {supervisor}, harvest of {crop} on {field} is planned for {harvest_plan} ({area_ha} ha). Please check the machines and the trailers the day before.
mt: 请检查机器和拖车前一天.

en: Hello {operator}, take {machine} to {field} for {task} (week of {week_start}, {planned_ha} ha). Please check fuel and grease first.
mt: 您好,请先检查燃料和油脂.

en: Hello {operator}, after spraying {field} on {date} please rinse the tank and the nozzles with clean water and drain the rinse away from ditches.
mt: 您好,在喷 {field} 之后,请用清洁的水冲洗水箱和喷嘴.

en: Hello {contractor}, we book {service} on {field} for {date}: {area_ha} ha at {rate_ha} per ha. Please confirm your crew and arrival time.
mt: 您的船员和抵达时间请确认.

en: Hello {contractor}, your crew is expected on {field} ({area_ha} ha) on {date}. Please bring your weigh record and call the gate on arrival.
mt: 您的船员在3号机场预计,请携带您的重量记录,并在抵达时给门打电话.

en: Hello {contractor}, please sign the work record for {field} ({area_ha} ha), done on {date}. Cost {cost}. Status: {state}.
mt: 您好,请签署工作记录. 完成于3日. 成本:40. 状态:{state}.

en: Hello, {field} ({crop}, {season}) gave {yield_ha} t/ha against a target of {target_t_ha}, {gap_t} t short. Please send the reasons before Friday.
mt: 请在星期五之前发送理由.

en: Hello {recorded_by}, frost is possible tonight, with lows near {tmin} C. Cover tender crops before dark and record the lowest temperature at first light.
mt: 今天晚上可能有,低温接近1摄氏度. 在黑暗之前覆盖嫩的作物,并在第一天亮时记录最低温度.

en: Hello, {kind} hit {field} on {date}: {area_ha} ha, damage {damage_pct}. Please inspect the {crop} today and send photos.
mt: 您好, {kind} 在 {date} 上击中 {field}: {area_ha} ha,损坏 {damage_pct}. 请今天检查 {crop} 并发送照片.

en: Hello, rain stops work. {task} on {field} ({planned_ha} ha, week of {week_start}) moves. Please send me a new plan by noon.
mt: 您好,下雨停止工作. 移动. 请在中午前给我发一个新的计划.

en: Hello {operator}, the weeding team goes to {field} ({area_ha} ha) using {method}: {workers} people, {hours} hours. Meet at the shed at 6:30.
mt: 您好,除草团队将使用3人,5小时,在6点半在棚里见面.

en: Hello, {field} needs replanting: {replant_ha} ha of {crop} after {cause}. Decision: {state}. Please prepare seed and the drill.
mt: 请准备种子和种子钻机.

en: Hello {recorded_by}, the weather log for {date} must be complete today: rain, lowest and highest temperature and wind. Please enter it.
mt: 您好,今天的天气日志必须完整:雨,最低和最高温度和风. 请输入它.

en: Hello, we return unopened {product}, batch {batch}, bought for {field}. Please collect it this week and send a credit note.
mt: 您好,我们收回未打开的分数,购买了分数,请在本周收取并发送信用单.

en: Hello, {kind} hit your field {field} on {date}. About {area_ha} ha are damaged ({damage_pct}), an estimated {loss_t} t. We will send the inspection report.
mt: 大约3公受损,估计5公.我们将发送检查报告.

en: Hello {operator}, please send your timesheet for {date} on {field}: {hours} hours with {machine}, crew of {crew}. Thank you.
mt: 请发送您的时间表, 时间为4小时, 机组人员为5人.

en: Hello {author}, the diary for {date} shows: {state}. Please enter the weather, the work and the issues by 6 pm every day.
mt: 您好,每天晚上6点之前请输入天气,工作和问题.

en: Hello, please check spray {sp_id}: {product} at {dose_l_ha} l/ha on {area_ha} ha of {field}, wind {wind_kmh} km/h. Wind check: {wind_state}.
mt: 您好,请检查喷雾 {sp_id}: {product} 在 {dose_l_ha} l/ha 在 {area_ha} ha 的 {field},风 {wind_kmh} km/h. 风检查: {wind_state}.
why: English/Latin words left: ha ha km h.

en: Hello {name}, you worked {week_avg} hours a week over the last four weeks against {hours_week} in your contract. Please talk to me about time off.
mt: 你在过去的四周里每周工作1个小时.请和我谈谈休假时间.

en: Hello {name}, your hours this month are {h_month} and this season {h_season}. Please check them and tell me about any mistake.
mt: 你的时间是这个月和这个季节. 请检查它们,并告诉我任何错误.

en: Weather: {col:diary.cond}, with {col:diary.rain} mm of rain recorded. People on site: {col:diary.people}.
mt: 天气: {col:diary.cond},记录下1毫米的雨.

en: Issues: {col:diary.issues}.
mt: 问题:

en: Conditions: wind {col:sprays.wind_kmh} km/h, temperature {col:sprays.temp_c} C. Wind check: {col:sprays.wind_state}. Operator: {col:sprays.operator}.
mt: 情况:风 {col:sprays.wind_kmh} 公里/小时,温度 {col:sprays.temp_c} C. 风检查: {col:sprays.wind_state}.操作员: {col:sprays.operator}.

en: People may enter the field again from {col:phi.entry_from} ({col:phi.rei} hours). Re-entry check: {col:phi.entry}.
mt: 人们可以从 {col:phi.entry_from} ({col:phi.rei}小时) 开始重新进入场地.

en: The planned harvest date is {col:phi.plan}. Harvest date check: {col:phi.clash}.
mt: 预计的收获日期是 {col:phi.plan}.

en: Scouting summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 查询总结,日期是1

en: Report {col:scout.sc_id} of {col:scout.date}. Field: {col:scout.field}. Crop: {col:scout.crop}. Scout: {col:scout.scout}.
mt: 报道: 农场: 农作物: 侦察员:

en: The report is {col:scout.age} days old. The crop adviser reads it at {col:scout.adv_phone} before any spray is ordered.
mt: 这份报告是0天前的. 农作物顾问在下令任何喷雾之前在1点阅读它.

en: Harvest report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 收获报告日期为 {set:firm}

en: The crop is at the stage {col:stages.stage}. The harvest was planned for {col:stages.harvest_plan}. Schedule check: {col:stages.state}.
mt: 农作物已经进入收获阶段. 收获计划于1日. 时间表检查: 2日.

en: This season {col:stages.loads_n} loads were weighed, {col:stages.loads_t} tonnes in total, at an average moisture of {col:stages.moist}. That is {col:stages.yield_now} tonnes per hectare on the whole field.
mt: 在这个季节,总量1,平均湿度为2,即整个田地每公3.

en: The field had {col:stages.ops_n} jobs and {col:stages.sprays_n} sprays this season, and {col:stages.rain_since} mm of rain since the start.
mt: 这场赛季有工作和喷雾, 开始以来降雨了2毫米.

en: Yield report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 收益率报告日期为 {set:firm}

en: The target was {col:yield.target_t_ha} tonnes per hectare, or {col:yield.target_t} tonnes. {col:yield.loads_n} loads were weighed, {col:yield.tonnes} tonnes in total, from {col:yield.harv_ha} hectares harvested.
mt: 目标是每公10,或1.

en: The yield is {col:yield.yield_ha} tonnes per hectare, which is {col:yield.vs_target} against the target. Verdict: {col:yield.state}. Tonnes below target: {col:yield.gap_t}.
mt: 产量为每公的0,这与目标相抵触.

en: The harvest is worth {col:yield.value} at {col:yield.price_t} per tonne. The average moisture was {col:yield.moist}.
mt: 收获价值为每1.平均湿度为2.

en: Weather summary of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 气象总结,日期为1

en: On {col:weather.date} the lowest temperature was {col:weather.tmin} C, the highest {col:weather.tmax} C, rain {col:weather.rain_mm} mm and wind {col:weather.wind_kmh} km/h. Work day check: {col:weather.work}.
mt: 在 {col:weather.date} 最低温度为 {col:weather.tmin} C,最高温度为 {col:weather.tmax} C,降雨 {col:weather.rain_mm} mm,风 {col:weather.wind_kmh} km/h. 工作日检查: {col:weather.work}.
why: English/Latin words left: mm km h.

en: In the month there were {col:weather.m_rain} mm of rain on {col:weather.m_rain_days} days. The average lowest temperature was {col:weather.m_tmin} C and {col:weather.m_lost} days were lost to weather.
mt: 在这个月中,在1天中降雨了 {col:weather.m_rain} mm.平均最低温度是 {col:weather.m_tmin} C,天气损失了 {col:weather.m_lost} 天.

en: Recorded by {col:weather.recorded_by}. The field limits are in the settings: rain that stops work {set:rain_stop} mm and storm wind {set:storm_wind} km/h.
mt: 场域限制在设置中:停工雨1毫米和风暴2公里/小时.

en: Hours this month: {col:crew.h_month}. Land work {col:crew.h_land}, crop care {col:crew.h_care}, irrigation {col:crew.h_irr}, harvest and haulage {col:crew.h_harv}. Hours this season: {col:crew.h_season}.
mt: 本月工作时间: {col:crew.h_month} 土地工作,作物护理,灌,收获和运输.
